events.outcome: Current LABAS rules directly confirm the €3/90-day account rule and 120-day hard number-loss boundary.

LABAS currently advertises direct eSIM entry from €1. The reviewed package page includes a €1 eSIM offer and a €1/month eSIM package with 1 GB, 100 minutes and 100 SMS. The €3 figure in the older profile is a qualifying retention top-up, not the current minimum direct acquisition price.

Current LABAS terms reconfirm that the account stays fully valid for 90 days from activation or the last top-up of at least €3. After 90 days without a qualifying top-up the line becomes receive-only for calls/SMS plus emergency outgoing; after 120 days the number is cancelled and cannot be restored.

LABAS currently requires prepaid registration and says citizens of any country can register online through biometric verification. Accepted online identity documents include passport, identity card, driver's licence or Lithuanian residence permit.

Remote identity registration does not establish universal offshore first activation. Current LABAS terms explicitly warn that service activation in foreign countries may be restricted under Lithuanian law, so the route must not be presented as guaranteed China-first or foreign-first activation.

LABAS current roaming material states that roaming allows customers to send and receive SMS abroad and lists China among supported non-EU roaming destinations. This supports ordinary roaming-SMS capability when registered on a partner network, but it is not evidence of bank/app OTP success.

data.tariffSummary: Current eSIM entry from €1; keep full service with a ≥€3 top-up every 90 days; 120-day hard number-loss boundary.
guideSteps: Use the current LABAS package page for the acquisition price; do not treat the €3 retention top-up as the SIM/eSIM purchase price.
Register the prepaid number. Foreign citizens can use the online biometric path with an accepted identity document.
Do not assume offshore first activation is guaranteed; current terms say activation in foreign countries may be restricted.
Top up at least €3 before each 90-day full-service deadline. Do not wait for the 120-day hard cancellation point.
Roaming supports ordinary SMS abroad, including supported China roaming, but verify any critical bank/app OTP separately because no exact service sample is established.
